newsitem.title: USA: AutoBond plans to offer fewer shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: AutoBond plans to offer fewer shares in IPO.

text.p: The number of shares to be offered in AutoBond Acceptance Corp's initial public offering has been lowered to 1.5 million shares from the 1,975,00 shares previously filed for, according to a revised filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The estimated price range has stayed unchanged at $11 to $13 per share.
No timing on the deal has been set as yet, according to lead underwriter Oppenheimer & Co. The proposed stock symbol for the company's shares on the Nasdaq is "ABND".
Autobond is a consumer finance company engaged in acquiring and servicing retail installment contracts originated by automobile dealers.
